user_intent: Add observability for OpenAI-compatible provider token usage and prompt cache statistics returned by DeepSeek or similar providers.
title: Record OpenAI-compatible provider usage and cache telemetry
description: Record provider usage diagnostics for self-iteration LLM runs so cache hit/miss behavior can be audited without changing prompt content, prompt ordering, agent contracts, governance rules, approval gates, provider credentials, or execution permissions.
expected_artifacts: Persist sanitized provider usage/cache diagnostics when returned by OpenAI-compatible chat providers
Add audit event metadata for prompt cache hit/miss counts
Regression test using a mocked provider response

request_fields.activation_policy: delayed; this request records a candidate code change for review and validation only, and it does not grant approval, apply any external provider action, or alter provider credentials.
request_fields.affected_governance_surface: LLM provider execution diagnostics for self-iteration runs. This is observability-only and must not change prompts, approval gates, workflow state transitions, permissions, or provider request semantics.
request_fields.current_problem: Large DeepSeek self-iteration calls report zero cache hits externally, but Abyss currently discards provider usage fields, making it impossible to audit prompt_cache_hit_tokens and prompt_cache_miss_tokens from local run records.
request_fields.old_rule_review: Prior accepted rules require self-iteration and provider-facing infrastructure changes to preserve Owner/Harness gates, avoid credential exposure, and avoid changing execution authority without explicit meta-governance review.
request_fields.owner_authority_impact: No Owner authority is delegated or reduced. The change only records sanitized numeric usage diagnostics returned by the provider and does not approve, apply, or execute changes.
request_fields.risk_assessment: Low-to-medium. The main risk is accidentally storing provider response content or secrets. Mitigation: persist only whitelisted numeric usage/cache fields plus non-sensitive provider/model/interface identifiers and prompt/result paths already present in audit metadata.
request_fields.rollback_plan: Revert the llm_executor telemetry helper, remove the usage diagnostics directory constant and test, and remove any new conftest redirection for that directory. Existing LLM execution should return to content-only behavior.
request_fields.validation_plan: Mock an OpenAI-compatible provider response containing usage fields, verify sanitized usage diagnostics are written and audit metadata includes cache hit/miss counts, then run full pytest and abyss_cli check.
request_fields.proposed_change: Change provider response plumbing to return response text plus optional diagnostics, extract whitelisted usage/cache fields from OpenAI-compatible responses, persist them under runtime process diagnostics, and include a compact summary in the llm.run audit event.

notes: Round 1 of the DeepSeek cache investigation: observability only, no prompt reordering.
